content.title: This is business banking
content.description: Take your finances further with the account designed for efficiency, and built for business.

content.title: The all-in-one business account
content.description: Scale and save with global payments, multi-currency accounts, and smarter spending.

content.title: More than just the essentials
content.description:
From the second you open your bank account, get everything you need to do business locally and globally. Fees and T&Cs apply.

  • Send transfers around the world with ease
  • Receive money with your IBAN and SWIFT/BIC account details
  • Accept payments online or in person
  • Exchange 25+ currencies at the interbank rate (within allowance, during market hours)
  • Pay salaries, taxes, and suppliers directly from your account
  • Integrate with Xero, Sage, QuickBooks, and 45+ other tools

content.title: Automate your spend, end-to-end
content.description:
Cut out the manual work and save your team hours every week. Fees may apply.

  • Issue physical and virtual cards for you and your team
  • Keep team spend secure with approvals and controls
  • Easily manage and reconcile expenses in-app with AI automations
  • Pay bills faster with Revolut BillPay

content.title: Expand with ease
content.description:
Use our suite of tools to understand your business better and scale your operations. Feature availability is subject to plan selection. Fees and T&Cs may apply.

  • Boost sales by accessing 80+ million Revolut customers with Revolut Pay
  • Dive into analytics to plan, manage, and track spend
  • Grow your money with interest paid daily on your savings balance
  • Manage currency risk with forward contracts, plus Limit and Stop orders
  • Control all your companies, branches, and business entities from one app
  • Leverage a cutting-edge fraud prevention system, proactive security features, and 24/7 customer support

items.title: How do I open a Revolut Business bank account?
items.description:
Opening a Revolut Business bank account is quick and easy.

  1. Fill out a short online form — it only takes about 10 minutes
  2. We’ll review your application as part of the account set-up process
  3. Once approved, we'll set up your account, and you'll be ready to go

We may reach out or leave you a message on your application to confirm a few details. If so, we'll guide you through the required information or documents.

Learn more.

items.title: Is Revolut Business a bank?
items.description:
Revolut Bank UK Ltd (Revolut Bank) is a bank in the UK, authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA), and regulated by both the PRA and the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).

Wherever we don't have a banking license, we offer many of the same features as a bank, and your money's protected by depositing with partner banks or investing in high-quality liquid assets.

Here's a quick overview:

  • We're a bank in the EEA, where we're authorised by the Bank of Lithuania
  • We're not yet a bank in the US, Australia, or Singapore. In these countries, we're a technology services provider that works with partner banks to offer our services

items.title: Am I eligible for a Revolut Business bank account?
items.description:
To open a Revolut Business bank account, your business needs to meet the following requirements:

  • Your company must be fully incorporated and active
  • Your company must be registered in the UK
  • Your company can't operate in unsupported industries
